fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} after {{fd|1.5}} seconds without moving, taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage, performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}}, {{tip|channel|channeling}}, or being in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}. '''Teemo''' will maintain stealth so long as he remains idle and is not {{tip|airborne|displaced}}. While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Teemo''' gains the stealth even while moving and can move without breaking stealth, but will lose the stealth in this case if he is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}}.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Element of Surprise:}} When '''Teemo''' breaks the stealth, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|key=%|20 to 80 for 4|1;5;10;15}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
